item.title: Leeds Council discusses public projects, water treatment business
item.description: Public Works projects and a potential environmental and water treatment business were the subjects of a meeting for the Leeds City Council on Wednesday night after it was rescheduled from Monday due to weather conditions.

item.title: Pinson hires Colafrancesco as new head football coach
item.description: The Pinson Valley Indians have found the man to lead their football program in Logan Colafrancesco. “Coach Cola,” as he is known, becomes Pinson’s sixth head football coach in the past eight years, the most recent being James Thompson, who was fired late in 2025.
